notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address. The link may be wrong, or the page was moved or deleted.

routeError.title: This page couldn't be loaded
routeError.chunkBody: The app was updated while this tab was open. Reload to continue.
routeError.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this page
routeError.forbiddenBody: Your account can't open this page. If you need it, ask your administrator.

appCrash.title: Something went wrong
appCrash.body: The app hit an unexpected problem and stopped. Reload the page to continue; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

widgetError.title: This section couldn't be shown
widgetError.body: The rest of the page still works.
